basic.name: Basic Dao
basic.description: A template Dao used for tests and scaffolding.

dao_reversal.name: Dao of Reversal
dao_reversal.description: A Heaven-defying Dao that conceives cause and effect as reversible flows. Techniques focus on rewinding small windows of time, reversing injury, and unlearning fixed truths.

reverse_pulse_sutra.name: Reverse Pulse Sutra
reverse_pulse_sutra.effect: +30% healing efficiency, risk of backlash (20% HP loss on failure).

temporal_echo.name: Temporal Echo
temporal_echo.effect: Undo one recent mistake or failed roll at 50% Dao Heart cost.

reversal_resonance.name: Reversal Resonance
reversal_resonance.effect: +12% efficiency for techniques with 'Flow', 'Cycle', or 'Return' keywords
